Title: Start the packaged demo
Setup: Use the provided launch script or run digs_demo from a terminal
Steps: Start the demo and wait for the title screen
Expected Result: The VOX + DIGS title screen appears without an error
Evidence Requested: Build ID and a title-screen screenshot

Title: Configure a match
Setup: Open Start Match from the title screen
Steps: Cycle bots from 0 through 3; select each map style; change the seed; select each arsenal
Expected Result: Every value changes within its documented range and Enter starts the selected match
Evidence Requested: Setup-screen screenshot and notes for any value that cannot be selected

Title: Restart the same seed
Setup: Start a match and make a visible terrain change
Steps: Press R and compare the regenerated terrain with the initial layout
Expected Result: The same map style and seed recreate the same starting terrain
Evidence Requested: Before-and-after screenshots with the visible seed

Title: Coal Ridge generation
Setup: Select Coal Ridge and a recorded seed
Steps: Start the match and inspect both sides of the arena
Expected Result: The arena is playable and contains layered destructible terrain plus an intact bedrock boundary
Evidence Requested: Seed and arena screenshot

Title: Deepworks generation
Setup: Select Deepworks and a recorded seed
Steps: Start the match and inspect caves and firedamp pockets
Expected Result: The arena is playable and exposes cave terrain with visible systemic material opportunities
Evidence Requested: Seed and arena screenshot

Title: Furnace Yard generation
Setup: Select Furnace Yard and a recorded seed
Steps: Start the match and inspect industrial terrain and sand
Expected Result: The arena is playable and has a layout distinct from Coal Ridge and Deepworks
Evidence Requested: Seed and arena screenshot

Title: Movement jump and steam jet
Setup: Start any match
Steps: Move left and right; jump; hold either Shift until steam drops; release Shift
Expected Result: Movement remains responsive; the miner jumps; steam provides lift and then recharges
Evidence Requested: Short capture or notes including frame cap and input device

Title: Pick and sledge terrain edits
Setup: Use Full Works and select keys 1 and 6
Steps: Aim at nearby terrain and use each tool several times
Expected Result: Pick makes precise edits and sledge makes a broader close-range impact
Evidence Requested: Before-and-after screenshots

Title: Projectile arsenal
Setup: Use Full Works and select keys 2 through 0
Steps: Fire every ranged weapon at terrain and at a miner while observing cooldowns
Expected Result: All eight ranged slots fire their documented projectile or material effect and affect the authoritative match
Evidence Requested: Short capture and a list of every slot tested

Title: Falling material behavior
Setup: Use a map or Foundry area containing sand and loose effects
Steps: Dislodge sand and observe it for several simulation seconds
Expected Result: Sand falls into available space instead of remaining suspended
Evidence Requested: Before-and-after screenshots

Title: Water lava cooling reaction
Setup: Use the Pressure Hose near lava
Steps: Direct water into lava and observe the contact region
Expected Result: The contact produces solid stone and hot smoke as the demo steam representation
Evidence Requested: Short capture focused on the contact cells

Title: Fire and firedamp reaction
Setup: Use Deepworks or the Foundry near firedamp and a heat source
Steps: Ignite the exposed gas and observe the bounded reaction
Expected Result: Firedamp ignites and produces a localized terrain blast without corrupting the match
Evidence Requested: Short capture plus seed and location

Title: Damage death gore and respawn
Setup: Start a match with at least one bot
Steps: Deal lethal damage and continue observing the victim
Expected Result: Health decreases; death produces voxel effects; the victim respawns after the fixed delay unless the match ended
Evidence Requested: Short capture and score before and after

Title: Authoritative bot combat
Setup: Start a match with 1 to 3 bots
Steps: Observe movement and combat for at least 30 seconds
Expected Result: Bots acquire targets; move; attack; take damage; die; and score through the same match rules
Evidence Requested: Seed bot count and 30-second notes or capture

Title: Rising lava endgame
Setup: Run a short test build or wait for the final 30 seconds of a classic match
Steps: Observe the bottom boundary and allow a miner to touch rising lava
Expected Result: Lava enters physical world cells; rises monotonically; and damages or kills a miner on contact
Evidence Requested: Timed screenshots or capture and the debug tick

Title: Lightfield quality tiers
Setup: Open Options and use the same scene for Compatibility Balanced and Showcase
Steps: Cycle all three tiers and inspect lava hot cells smoke and shadowed terrain
Expected Result: Each tier renders correctly and higher tiers show wider light propagation without changing gameplay state
Evidence Requested: Three matched screenshots with tier labels

Title: Frame-cap choices
Setup: Open Options and enable the F1 overlay
Steps: Test 30 60 90 120 144 and Unlimited for at least 10 seconds each
Expected Result: Every cap can be selected; presentation remains responsive; simulation advances at fixed 60 Hz
Evidence Requested: Overlay notes for every cap

Title: Debug overlay
Setup: Start a match and press F1
Steps: Observe the overlay while moving firing and changing materials
Expected Result: The overlay toggles cleanly and its tick hash material and performance fields continue updating
Evidence Requested: Screenshot of the enabled overlay

Title: Resize letterbox and fullscreen
Setup: Run the graphical demo in a desktop session
Steps: Resize to wide and tall windows; press F11 twice
Expected Result: The image keeps its aspect ratio with stable letterboxing and fullscreen round-trips without a crash
Evidence Requested: Screenshots and desktop resolution or refresh rate

Title: Pause results and restart
Setup: Start a scored match
Steps: Press Esc; resume; reach results by score or time; start another match
Expected Result: Pause stops active play; resume returns safely; results are readable; a new match initializes cleanly
Evidence Requested: Capture or notes for each transition

Title: Procedural audio and silent fallback
Setup: Run once with a working audio device and once with audio unavailable
Steps: Fire tools and weapons in both runs
Expected Result: Procedural effects play when audio opens and gameplay continues without a crash when audio is unavailable
Evidence Requested: Audio device description and terminal output

Title: Non-windowed smoke test
Setup: Use the same digs_demo binary supplied for interactive testing
Steps: Run digs_demo --smoke-test smoke.ppm
Expected Result: The command exits zero; prints state and frame hashes; and writes a nonempty PPM without opening a window
Evidence Requested: smoke.log smoke.ppm and binary checksum

Title: CPU renderer benchmark
Setup: Close unrelated heavy workloads and record the power state
Steps: Run digs_demo --benchmark 240
Expected Result: The command exits zero and reports timing FPS and stable frame hashes for all three Lightfield tiers
Evidence Requested: benchmark.log plus CPU OS build type and power state

Title: Headless proof binaries
Setup: Use a tester bundle containing vox_headless and digs_headless beside digs_demo
Steps: Run both headless binaries
Expected Result: Each command exits zero and prints a deterministic state summary
Evidence Requested: vox-headless.log and digs-headless.log

Title: Repeat smoke hashes
Setup: Use one unchanged binary and machine
Steps: Run the smoke test twice with separate output names
Expected Result: Simulation and frame hashes match across both runs
Evidence Requested: Two smoke logs and checksums

Title: Weapon and effect pool stress
Setup: Use Full Works in Foundry or a long match
Steps: Fire rapid weapons and overlapping explosives repeatedly for at least 60 seconds
Expected Result: Bounded pool exhaustion remains safe and the match continues without a crash or corrupt terrain
Evidence Requested: 60-second capture terminal output and final state

Title: Test-bench profile
Setup: Use the intended GTX 1660 Ti laptop or another declared system
Steps: Complete launch smoke benchmark and one interactive match
Expected Result: Results clearly distinguish CPU software-renderer evidence from GPU presence and do not imply unmeasured GPU acceleration
Evidence Requested: Completed Environment sheet and cockpit evidence packet

Title: Clean exit
Setup: Start from the title screen and from a paused match
Steps: Quit through the menu and repeat with the window close control
Expected Result: The process exits promptly without a crash dialog or orphaned window
Evidence Requested: Terminal exit status and notes
